supply_check.scope: terms, checked, search_returned_nothing and not_checked_yet count every term in the window; terms_our_search_found_nothing_for lists published terms only

public_report_page.note: Separate later report-page observation; not the same snapshot as the API preview. No change or causal trend inferred.

pricing_change.note: Both paid routes now serve the same grouped needs. The free feed previously exposed all terms with a week delay; now it exposes a limited preview. Historical purchases retain their original prices.

limitations: Selected public aggregates only; no raw query labels, identities, paid report contents or licensed historical dataset acquired.
Publisher counts are not independently replayed settlements or distinct customers. Supplier-paid submissions are not buyer demand and may include operator-funded verification costs.
No causal effect of the price change can be inferred from two cumulative snapshots. No new buyer-side purchase is reported in the interval, including no reported purchase at the new price.
The API preview and public report page have different generation timestamps and different report populations. Do not merge their counts or treat raw search terms as grouped needs.
No AgentMine buyer outcomes, prices accepted, savings, revenue or margin verified.
